items.name: comp-22
items.title: Input With Button
items.blurb: Email input with a spaced Send button.
items.use: You want a clearer visual separation between input and action, or the button needs to be independently styled.
items.text: An email input with an outline Button component separated by a gap. Uses standard Button component styling with outline variant. Space is tight or you need a merged input+button look.

items.name: comp-220
items.title: Status Select
items.blurb: Select for status values with colored indicator dots.
items.use: Picking workflow or task statuses where visual color coding aids recognition.
items.text: A select where each option shows a colored circular SVG dot followed by a status label. Dots use semantic colors (green, blue, amber, gray, red). Simple text-only selections or when color alone is insufficient for a11y.

items.name: comp-224
items.title: Plan Description Select
items.blurb: Select with plan names and descriptions.
items.use: Selecting between tiered plans or products where context is essential.
items.text: A select for plans where each option shows a plan title and a small gray description underneath. Descriptions are hidden in the trigger via CSS. Simple choices without supplementary information.

items.name: comp-228
items.title: Portrait Avatar Select
items.blurb: Select with portrait-style user profiles.
items.use: Selecting users with rich profile information.
items.text: A select to pick users with larger avatars, names, and usernames. The trigger expands in height to fit portrait items. Simple lists or when space is limited.

items.name: comp-229
items.title: Searchable Combobox Select
items.blurb: Searchable combobox with keyboard navigation.
items.use: Lists are long and filtering by typing speeds up selection.
items.text: A combobox built with Popover and Command, allowing users to search/filter options from a list and select via keyboard or click. Short lists where Select suffices or keyboard users can't reach it.

items.name: comp-23
items.title: Password Visibility Toggle
items.blurb: Password input that toggles between masked and visible text.
items.use: Users need to verify their typed password before submitting a login or signup form.
items.text: A password field with an eye icon button that toggles between password and text input types. Tracks visibility state with useState. You need to support paste-based passwords or accessibility requirements that disallow unmasked passwords.

items.name: comp-230
items.title: Combobox With Action
items.blurb: Searchable combobox with action button.
items.use: Long lists plus the ability to create a new item inline.
items.text: A combobox with search built on Popover and Command, plus an action button at the bottom (e.g., 'New organization'). Simple selections or modal creation workflows.

items.name: comp-231
items.title: Searchable Timezone Select
items.blurb: Searchable timezone picker with Intl offsets.
items.use: Users need to find a timezone quickly from a long list.
items.text: A searchable combobox for all supported timezones with GMT offsets. Uses Intl API and custom search filter. Short timezone lists or non-searchable layouts.

items.name: comp-232
items.title: Flag Country Combobox
items.blurb: Searchable country picker with flag emojis.
items.use: Picking countries where search and visual flags aid selection.
items.text: A combobox for countries grouped by continent, with flag emojis and search filtering. Simple static country lists or when emojis aren't supported.

items.name: comp-233
items.title: Icon Count Combobox
items.blurb: Searchable combobox with icons and item counts.
items.use: Selecting from categorized items with counts or statistics.
items.text: A combobox showing service categories with icons and numeric counts. Each option displays icon, label, and count. Simple text lists or when counts are distracting.

items.name: comp-238
items.title: Multi-Select Listbox
items.blurb: Multi-select listbox using React Aria.
items.use: Users need to select multiple related items from a visible list.
items.text: A listbox for selecting multiple items built on React Aria. Supports keyboard navigation and shows all selected items at once. Single selection or when search is needed for large lists.

items.name: comp-24
items.title: Clearable Text Input
items.blurb: Text input that shows a clear button when text is present.
items.use: Forms where users frequently need to reset fields or delete accidental input.
items.text: A text input with a conditionally rendered CircleXIcon button that clears the field and refocuses the input. State is managed with useState and useRef. Required fields that should not be clearable or the input is read-only.

items.name: comp-245
items.title: Slider Reference Labels
items.blurb: Slider with reference labels marking specific values on the track.
items.use: Users need clear visual anchors for important values on the range.
items.text: A slider with tick marks or labels aligned to specific values along the track, aiding value reference. When tick marks clutter the interface.

items.name: comp-246
items.title: Slider With Ticks
items.blurb: Slider with tick marks at regular intervals.
items.use: A design wants to show discrete intervals or step values.
items.text: A slider showing evenly-spaced tick marks along the track, providing visual reference points. Continuous ranges where ticks add visual clutter.

items.name: comp-25
items.title: Search Keyboard Shortcut Input
items.blurb: Search input displaying a keyboard shortcut hint (⌘K).
items.use: Apps that support search via keyboard shortcut and want to hint at it inline.
items.text: A search input with a read-only kbd element showing ⌘K in the end. The shortcut display is purely visual and non-interactive. The keyboard shortcut handler is not actually implemented elsewhere in the app.

items.name: comp-251
items.title: Dual Range With Output
items.blurb: Dual-thumb range slider with the selected min and max shown as text above.
items.use: Choose a numeric range with a live readout of both ends.
items.text: A range slider paired with two input fields, allowing both drag and direct number entry for min and max. Simple range selection; dual controls add visual complexity.

items.name: comp-252
items.title: Volume Slider
items.blurb: Horizontal volume slider with speaker icons at each end and a value, inside a settings card.
items.use: Volume or level control inside a settings card.
items.text: A vertical slider track with a volume-icon indicator, typical for audio/video applications. Horizontal layouts or non-media UIs.

items.name: comp-254
items.title: Temperature Slider Input
items.blurb: Single slider with a number input and a reset-to-default button with tooltip.
items.use: Adjust a value with a quick reset to its default.
items.text: A slider pair styled for temperature selection, showing a numeric value and often a unit indicator. Generic range selection; the temperature context must be relevant.

items.name: comp-255
items.title: Slider With Input
items.blurb: Volume slider with a small editable number box showing the current value.
items.use: Users need both tactile (slider) and precise (input) value control.
items.text: A slider and text input in sync, allowing drag or direct typing to set a value. Simple one-method input suffices.

items.name: comp-256
items.title: Emoji Rating Slider
items.blurb: Range slider with emoji faces representing satisfaction levels.
items.use: Collecting emotional/satisfaction feedback in a playful way.
items.text: A slider where the thumb or track markers display emoji (😞 to 😄) representing rating or satisfaction. Formal or accessibility-critical contexts where emoji may not be clear.

items.name: comp-259
items.title: Slider With Buttons
items.blurb: Slider with increment/decrement buttons flanking the track.
items.use: Users prefer button-based stepping alongside continuous drag.
items.text: A slider with +/- buttons on each side for step-based value adjustment, plus a draggable track. When buttons add visual clutter.

items.name: comp-260
items.title: Price Range Slider
items.blurb: Large dual-thumb range slider under a price range heading, beside a Go button.
items.use: Pick a price or numeric range with a bold, oversized control.
items.text: A range slider with currency symbol or price labels, designed for e-commerce price selection. Non-price ranges where currency styling would confuse.

items.name: comp-261
items.title: Vertical Slider
items.blurb: Single-value slider with a vertical orientation.
items.use: Design space allows vertical layout or the value semantically represents height/depth.
items.text: A vertically-oriented slider for selecting a single value, useful for height/depth controls. When horizontal is expected by users.

items.name: comp-264
items.title: Object Position Slider
items.blurb: Three sliders for X, Y and Z position with number inputs and a reset button.
items.use: Adjust x, y and z offsets of an object with precise inputs.
items.text: A 2D slider allowing independent X and Y value selection via dragging, useful for object positioning. Simple 1D ranges or when axis confusion would occur.

items.name: comp-265
items.title: Histogram Range Slider
items.blurb: Price range slider over a histogram, with min and max inputs and a show results button.
items.use: Filter products by price with distribution context.
items.text: A range slider with a histogram background showing data distribution, common for image or signal filtering. When histogram data is unavailable or irrelevant.

items.name: comp-266
items.title: Audio Equalizer Slider
items.blurb: Array of vertical sliders styled as an audio equalizer.
items.use: Audio/audio-adjacent interfaces for band control.
items.text: Multiple vertical sliders arranged in a row, each controlling a frequency band or level, styled like an audio EQ. When the audio metaphor does not apply.

items.name: comp-269
items.title: Error Inline Alert
items.blurb: Inline error alert with red icon.
items.use: Displaying form validation errors or inline error messages without requiring user action.
items.text: Minimal inline alert for error messages using a red error icon from lucide-react. No dismiss action; purely informational for error display. Critical errors needing explicit user interaction or confirmation. Dense layouts with space constraints.

items.name: comp-27
items.title: Search Input With Loader
items.blurb: Search input that shows a spinning loader when text is entered.
items.use: Search forms that need visual feedback during a query, with voice input as an alternative.
items.text: A search field with a magnifying glass that becomes a spinning LoaderCircleIcon on input. A mic button on the right for voice search. Loading state is simulated with useEffect. The loader timing doesn't match your actual API call duration (500ms is hardcoded).

items.name: comp-277
items.title: Error List Alert
items.blurb: Error alert with bulleted list of issues.
items.use: Form validation with multiple errors that need to be listed and addressed by the user.
items.text: Error alert that displays multiple error messages as a bulleted list. Useful for form validation showing all failures at once. Single errors. When space is constrained or error count is very high (10+).

items.name: comp-28
items.title: Number Stepper Input
items.blurb: Number input with plus and minus buttons on either side.
items.use: Forms needing precise numeric input with visual increment/decrement controls, or where keyboard navigation is essential.
items.text: A number field with minus and plus buttons flanking a centered numeric input. Built with React Aria NumberField, supporting arrow keys and button clicks. Defaults to 2048 with minValue of 0. You need custom value constraints beyond minValue or locale-specific formatting.

items.name: comp-283
items.title: Warning Alert Banner
items.blurb: Amber warning banner with icon, message, action link, and close button.
items.use: You need to show persistent, dismissible warning alerts with secondary actions that remain visible until closed.
items.text: Static warning alert banner with TriangleAlert icon, message text, optional action link, and dismissible close button. No interaction hooks. For system-wide stacked notifications; use a toast system that queues messages instead.

items.name: comp-288
items.title: Success With Undo Actions
items.blurb: Success notification with message and dual action buttons (View, Undo).
items.use: You need to confirm an action with options to view the result or undo, without interrupting the user.
items.text: Static success notification with green checkmark, single message line, two action buttons separated by a divider, and dismissible close. For stacked or auto-dismissing notifications; use a toast system for non-persistent alerts.

items.name: comp-290
items.title: Error Notification Card
items.blurb: Error card with title, description, action button, and dismiss.
items.use: You need to display an error that requires attention with explanatory text and a clear action path.
items.text: Static error notification card with red alert icon, bold title, descriptive text, action button, and dismissible close. Larger vertical card layout. For quick, dismissible error messages or simple alerts; use smaller banner alerts instead.

items.name: comp-293
items.title: Cookie Consent Prompt
items.blurb: Cookie consent prompt with title, description, and accept/decline buttons.
items.use: You need to display a cookie consent request with clear acceptance and rejection options.
items.text: Static cookie consent notification card with title, explanation, Accept and Decline buttons, and dismissible close. For user-initiated preference toggles; this is for initial notices only.

items.name: comp-294
items.title: App Update Notification
items.blurb: App update notification with version, description, and install/later buttons.
items.use: You need to prompt users about an available app or software update.
items.text: Static app update notification with refresh icon, version heading, description, Install and Later buttons, and dismissible close. For required system updates; consider an interstitial modal instead.

items.name: comp-295
items.title: Social Mention Notification
items.blurb: Social mention notification with avatar, name, and accept/decline buttons.
items.use: You need to notify about social mentions or project collaborations with user context.
items.text: Static social mention notification with user avatar, linked names for person and project, timestamp, accept/decline buttons, and dismissible close. For direct messages or system alerts; use a dedicated messaging system instead.

items.name: comp-296
items.title: Live Event Notification
items.blurb: Live event notification with countdown and notify button.
items.use: You need to alert users about upcoming live events with an option to receive notifications.
items.text: Static live event notification with radio icon, event title, date/time, notify button, and dismissible close. For past events or non-urgent information; use a standard banner instead.

items.name: comp-300
items.title: Custom Sonner Toast
items.blurb: Trigger button for custom Sonner toast with rich content and multiple actions.
items.use: You need to display rich, multi-action notifications using Sonner's custom rendering.
items.text: Button that programmatically triggers a custom-rendered Sonner toast with success icon, message, and dual action buttons (View, Undo). For simple notifications; use the basic Sonner API instead.

items.name: comp-301
items.title: Cookie Consent Banner
items.blurb: Full-width cookie consent banner with message and accept/decline buttons.
items.use: You need a persistent, full-width cookie consent notice that matches page layout.
items.text: Full-width cookie consent banner with message text and two action buttons, responsive layout (stacked on mobile, inline on desktop). For modal-style consents; use a card or modal component instead.

items.name: comp-302
items.title: Dark Announcement Banner
items.blurb: Dark announcement banner with emoji, headline text, and link.
items.use: You need to announce a new feature or update with a dark, prominent style.
items.text: Full-width dark-themed announcement banner with emoji, announcement headline, and linked arrow icon with hover animation. For cookie notices or required consents; use appropriate modal or card instead.

items.name: comp-305
items.title: Dismissible Feature Banner
items.blurb: Dark dismissible feature banner with icon, message, link, and close button.
items.use: You need a dismissible feature announcement that users can close permanently.
items.text: Full-width dark-themed feature banner with eclipse icon, message, Learn more link, and dismissible close button. Uses useState for visibility. For non-dismissible announcements; use comp-304 instead.

items.name: comp-307
items.title: Feature Launch Banner
items.blurb: Dark feature launch banner with icon, message, download and link buttons.
items.use: You need to launch a feature with prominent download action and secondary learn option.
items.text: Full-width dark-themed feature launch banner with eclipse icon, message, Download primary button, Learn more link-style button, and dismissible close. For single-action announcements; use simpler banners instead.

items.name: comp-309
items.title: Feature Launch Banner
items.blurb: Dark feature launch banner with rocket icon, title, description, and try now…
items.use: You need a prominent feature launch with rich content (title + description) and clear call-to-action.
items.text: Full-width dark-themed feature launch with rocket icon in colored circle background, title, description text, Try now button, and dismissible close. For simple announcements; use simpler banners instead.

items.name: comp-310
items.title: Sale Countdown Banner
items.blurb: Sale countdown banner with live timer, ticket icon, and buy now button.
items.use: You need to create urgency for a time-limited sale with a visible countdown.
items.text: Dark sale banner with ticket icon, sale headline, live countdown timer showing days/hours/minutes/seconds via useEffect RAF loop, Buy now button, and dismissible close. For non-time-critical promotions; use simpler announcement banners instead.

items.name: comp-312
items.title: Version Update Banner
items.blurb: Version update banner with version number, description, and update button.
items.use: You need to prompt users to update to a new version with status feedback.
items.text: Muted background banner showing version number, feature description, and Update now button. Button shows loading spinner via useState during simulated download. For required updates; use a modal or more intrusive pattern instead.

items.name: comp-314
items.title: Alert Dialog With Icon
items.blurb: Example alert dialog with icon and responsive title/description layout.
items.use: Creating a visually distinctive alert with an icon for emphasis.
items.text: A premade alert dialog template showing how to add an icon alongside the header, with responsive flex layout. For production code: use AlertDialog directly to avoid duplication.

items.name: comp-318
items.title: Sticky Footer Dialog
items.blurb: Example FAQ dialog with sticky footer while content scrolls above.
items.use: Building dialogs where buttons should remain visible while scrolling through long content.
items.text: A premade dialog template showing how to keep action buttons fixed at the bottom while content scrolls independently. When footer scrolling is acceptable: this requires custom layout.

items.name: comp-319
items.title: Terms Acceptance Dialog
items.blurb: Example terms dialog requiring scroll to bottom before acceptance.
items.use: Building terms/legal dialogs where reading compliance is required.
items.text: A premade dialog template for terms acceptance that tracks scroll position and enables the action button only when the user has read to the bottom. For optional reading: use a standard dialog instead.

items.name: comp-32
items.title: Floating Label Input
items.blurb: Email input with label that floats to top on focus.
items.use: Modern, polished forms where the floating label UX is expected and preferred.
items.text: An email field where the label starts centered and smoothly animates upward when focused or when text is entered. Uses CSS :has() selector and focus-within to trigger animation. You need to support older browsers without :has() selector support.

items.name: comp-320
items.title: Delete Confirm Dialog
items.blurb: Requires typing the project name to confirm a destructive action.
items.use: Protecting against accidental deletion of projects, accounts, or other irreversible resources.
items.text: A shadcn Dialog with a warning icon and text input that enables the delete button only after the user types the exact project name to confirm. Low-stakes or easily reversible actions: the confirmation friction is only justified for destructive operations.

items.name: comp-321
items.title: Newsletter Subscribe Dialog
items.blurb: Modal to collect email addresses for newsletter subscriptions.
items.use: Converting website visitors into newsletter subscribers or email list signups.
items.text: A shadcn Dialog containing an email input with a mail icon, subscribe button, and privacy policy notice. When users have already opted in: repeated prompts damage trust.

items.name: comp-322
items.title: Feedback Dialog
items.blurb: Modal for collecting user feedback with helpful resource links.
items.use: Enabling users to submit feature requests, bug reports, or general feedback without leaving the current page.
items.text: A shadcn Dialog with a textarea for feedback, links to tutorials and documentation, and a send button. When feedback is better handled through dedicated support channels: a modal interrupts the user's workflow.

items.name: comp-323
items.title: Rating Dialog
items.blurb: Gathers ratings on a 0-8 scale with an optional explanation.
items.use: Collecting structured feedback on onboarding difficulty, feature usability, or user satisfaction with explanations.
items.text: A shadcn Dialog with a 9-option radio button scale (0-8) and textarea for explaining the rating, separated by a header border. Touch-only interfaces where small radio buttons are difficult to select; consider a simpler star or thumbs-up scale…

items.name: comp-324
items.title: OTP Verify Dialog
items.blurb: Modal for entering and verifying a 4-digit OTP code.
items.use: Two-factor authentication or email verification flows requiring users to confirm a code sent to their registered…
items.text: A shadcn Dialog with a 4-slot OTP input using the input-otp library; displays success on valid code or error on invalid, with a resend link. When you need to support variable-length OTP codes: the slot count is hardcoded to 4.

items.name: comp-325
items.title: Sign Up Dialog
items.blurb: Modal for new account creation with name, email, and password.
items.use: Onboarding new users with a lightweight, non-navigating sign-up flow embedded in the page.
items.text: A shadcn Dialog collecting full name, email, and password; includes a Google authentication option and terms link. When password creation requires complex validation rules or multi-step verification: the form is intentionally minimal.

items.name: comp-326
items.title: Sign In Dialog
items.blurb: Modal for account login with email, password, and remember-me option.
items.use: Authenticating returning users with a lightweight, non-navigating sign-in flow embedded in the page.
items.text: A shadcn Dialog with email and password fields, a remember-me checkbox, forgot-password link, and Google login option. When you need robust credential validation or multi-factor authentication: the form is intentionally minimal.

items.name: comp-327
items.title: Invite Members Dialog
items.blurb: Invite team members via email or shareable magic link.
items.use: Onboarding team members through email invitations or sharing referral links with your product.
items.text: A shadcn Dialog with dynamically addable email input fields and a read-only magic link with copy-to-clipboard button. When you have no referral or team invitation system: the component assumes both email and link-based invitation are…

items.name: comp-328
items.title: Card Details Dialog
items.blurb: Modal for updating credit card payment details.
items.use: Collecting or updating payment card information in account settings or checkout flows.
items.text: A shadcn Dialog using react-payment-inputs for card number, expiry, and CVC fields; includes name, card type detection, and default payment method checkbox. On mobile with limited keyboard space: card inputs are best on desktop; handle sensitive data securely on the backend.

items.name: comp-330
items.title: Change Plan Dialog
items.blurb: Modal for selecting a new subscription plan with pricing and features.
items.use: Allowing existing users to upgrade or downgrade their subscription plan with transparent pricing.
items.text: A shadcn Dialog with radio-button plan selector (Essential, Standard, Enterprise) and a checklist of included features. With many plans or complex feature differences: the dialog is optimized for simple 3-plan choices.

items.name: comp-331
items.title: Edit Profile Dialog
items.blurb: Modal for updating profile with name, bio, website, and image uploads.
items.use: Allowing users to update their profile information including photos, name, website, and biography.
items.text: A scrollable shadcn Dialog with background and avatar image uploads, name fields, website, bio with character counter. For very large files or complex image cropping: this form handles basic file uploads and previews.

items.name: comp-332
items.title: Onboarding Stepper Dialog
items.blurb: Multi-step onboarding dialog with progress indicators and skip option.
items.use: Guiding new users through product features or setup with informational steps.
items.text: A shadcn Dialog with 4 steps, each displaying an image, title, and description; progress dots show current position; next/okay buttons advance. For complex workflows requiring data collection between steps: this is a read-only tour.

items.name: comp-34
items.title: Character Limit Input
items.blurb: Text input showing current and maximum character count.
items.use: Forms where users need to see how much space they have left (bios, tweets, comments).
items.text: A text input with maxLength 50 displaying character count as 'X/50' in the bottom right. Uses a custom useCharacterLimit hook to track input state. The character limit is context-dependent or changes dynamically.

items.name: comp-342
items.title: Accordion Icon Subheader Chevron
items.blurb: Accordion with icon, header, and subheader on the left with chevron.
items.use: Icon + text headers with category indicators, subheader descriptions.
items.text: Leading icon (left side) with header and subheader text, chevron on right. Simple text-only headers.

items.name: comp-352
items.title: Multi-Level Nested Accordion
items.blurb: Multi-level nested accordion allowing deep hierarchies.
items.use: Complex hierarchical content (e.g., product categories with subcategories).
items.text: Accordion items can contain nested accordion items, enabling category/subcategory structures. Flat FAQ lists.

items.name: comp-359
items.title: Image Tooltip
items.blurb: A tooltip containing a preview image above title and body text.
items.use: Previewing file thumbnails, screenshots, or images on hover.
items.text: Tooltip displaying a static image preview at the top, with title and description text below. Performance-critical UIs; loading images in tooltips can cause flicker and delays.

items.name: comp-360
items.title: Directional Pan Tooltips
items.blurb: Four directional buttons in a cross layout, each with a tooltip showing…
items.use: Camera/pan controls, directional navigation, or mapping interfaces that benefit from visual arrangement.
items.text: 3x3 grid of arrow buttons arranged in a directional pad layout. Each button has a tooltip displaying the action and a keyboard shortcut in a kbd element. Touch-only interfaces; the tight grid is hard to tap.

items.name: comp-361
items.title: Stats Tooltip
items.blurb: A tooltip showing stats in a two-column label/value grid.
items.use: Showing deployment status, code metrics, or any multi-stat summary in a compact tooltip.
items.text: Tooltip displaying a list of metric names on the left and their values on the right in a compact grid format. Very long stat names or many rows; content can overflow.

items.name: comp-362
items.title: Chart Data Tooltip
items.blurb: A tooltip showing chart-like data with colored bullet points and rows.
items.use: Dashboard tooltips that show data point details at a glance (sales, revenue, costs).
items.text: Tooltip displaying a date header and multi-row chart data, each row with a colored circle indicator and label/value pair. Complex visualizations; tooltips should stay simple and scannable.

items.name: comp-364
items.title: User Profile Hovercard
items.blurb: Username link that opens a hovercard showing full profile, bio, and mutual…
items.use: User profile previews in discussions, mentions, or social contexts.
items.text: Text link that triggers a hover card displaying avatar, full name, handle, bio, and a stack of mutual friend avatars with count. Touch-only interfaces; requires hover to activate.

items.name: comp-365
items.title: Article Preview Hovercard
items.blurb: Thumbnail link that opens a hovercard showing article title, description, and…
items.use: Article/content preview cards in feeds, related articles, or recommendations.
items.text: Image link that triggers a hover card displaying article title, summary text, read time, and last update date. Includes an arrow pointer. Touch-only interfaces; requires hover to activate.

items.name: comp-371
items.title: Checkbox Dropdown Menu
items.blurb: Dropdown menu with checkbox toggle items.
items.use: Allowing users to toggle multiple options from a compact dropdown.
items.text: A stateful dropdown where each item is a checkbox that toggles a boolean value. Supports disabled state. Single selection or dedicated filter panels.

items.name: comp-374
items.title: Rich Icon Dropdown
items.blurb: Full-featured dropdown with icons, submenus, and controls.
items.use: App menus with settings, options, and complex user control in one place.
items.text: A comprehensive dropdown combining icons, keyboard shortcuts, nested submenus with radio buttons and checkboxes for controlling settings. Simple menus or mobile-first interfaces where this complexity is unwieldy.

items.name: comp-377
items.title: Avatar Account Menu
items.blurb: Avatar button with dropdown account menu.
items.use: User profile access in navbar or header using avatar as the button.
items.text: A dropdown menu triggered by an Avatar component with optional fallback, showing user name/email and account actions. When a dedicated account settings page is preferred.

items.name: comp-379
items.title: Content Block Picker
items.blurb: Content block picker menu with icons and descriptions.
items.use: Page builders or editors where users add different block types.
items.text: A dropdown menu for adding content blocks (text, quote, heading). Each item shows an icon, title, and description. Simple action menus.

items.name: comp-380
items.title: Theme Switcher Dropdown
items.blurb: Theme switcher dropdown (light/dark/system).
items.use: Allowing users to control light/dark/system theme.
items.text: A dropdown menu to switch between light, dark, and system theme preferences. The trigger button shows the current theme icon. When theme is automatically determined.

items.name: comp-383
items.title: Avatar Notification Feed
items.blurb: Notification bell with popover list showing user avatars and activity timeline.
items.use: You need a visual notification center with user context (avatars) for activity feeds.
items.text: Bell icon button with unread badge, opens Popover showing notification list with user avatars, actions, timestamps, Mark all as read button, and unread indicators. For text-only notifications; use comp-382 without avatars instead.

items.name: comp-384
items.title: Interactive Tooltip Popover
items.blurb: A popover styled like a tooltip, with interactive content and a call-to-action…
items.use: Tooltips that need an action button or interactive element within.
items.text: Popover (not a pure tooltip) containing title, description text, and an interactive button. Used for richer content that requires interaction. Simple text hints; popovers are heavier than tooltips.

items.name: comp-386
items.title: Paginated Tour Tooltip
items.blurb: Paginated tour popover with left/right arrow buttons for navigation between…
items.use: Guided tours with many steps where users should navigate freely (not just forward).
items.text: Multi-step tour popover with previous/next buttons and step counter. Buttons disable at the first and last steps. Linear flows where users should only move forward.

items.name: comp-387
items.title: Share Link Popover
items.blurb: Popover for sharing content via link or social platforms.
items.use: Allowing users to share content to social media or copy a shareable link without navigating away.
items.text: A shadcn Popover with social sharing buttons (Twitter, Facebook, Email, Embed) and a copy-to-clipboard link field. When you need to track social shares or integrate with third-party analytics: button clicks are display-only.

items.name: comp-389
items.title: Anchored Product Tour
items.blurb: Product tour that anchors a popover to different grid items, cycling through…
items.use: Product tours that highlight multiple elements on the page and explain each one.
items.text: Interactive tour that shows a grid of numbered cards. Clicking 'Start tour' opens a popover anchored to the active card, cycling through tour steps. Mobile or responsive layouts where card positions shift.

items.name: comp-394
items.title: Avatar Online Status
items.blurb: Avatar with green online status indicator.
items.use: Chat apps, messaging, team interfaces with presence status.
items.text: Avatar with a small colored dot (e.g., emerald) in the corner showing 'Online'. Static user lists without status.

items.name: comp-398
items.title: Avatar Notification Count
items.blurb: Avatar with notification count badge.
items.use: Messaging, notification centers, inbox indicators.
items.text: Avatar with a small number badge (e.g., '3') showing notifications or message count. When notification count is elsewhere.

items.name: comp-409
items.title: Avatar Group Overflow
items.blurb: Avatar group with overflow indicator showing additional hidden avatars.
items.use: When displaying multiple avatars but limited space, showing a count of hidden team members or social proof at a glance.
items.text: Renders four circular avatars at 40px size with negative margins, plus a secondary-colored button showing "+3" to indicate more avatars are hidden. Uses a Button component with hover effects. When all avatars fit on screen, or when the count of hidden avatars is unknown or dynamic.

items.name: comp-412
items.title: Social Proof Avatars
items.blurb: Social proof badge showing avatars with trust message.
items.use: Header or hero sections where a trust badge adds credibility, showing user count and visual social proof together.
items.text: Renders four circular avatars at 20px size inside a bordered pill with text saying 'Trusted by 60K+ developers.' The avatars have ring-1 borders and are tightly packed with negative margins. When the developer count is not a selling point, or when space is extremely limited.

items.name: comp-424
items.title: Removable Badge
items.blurb: Badge with an X button to dismiss or remove it.
items.use: Removable tags, chip inputs, or dismissible labels.
items.text: Badge component with integrated close button; typically stateful in parent. Static labels that should not be removed.

items.name: comp-433
items.title: Tabs With Icon Badges
items.blurb: Tabs with icon badges showing additional status.
items.use: Tabs requiring status badges, notification counts, or icon indicators.
items.text: Tab buttons with icon badges displaying notification counts or status indicators. Icons accompany tab labels. Simple text-only tab navigation.

items.name: comp-436
items.title: Browser Icon Tabs
items.blurb: Browser-style tabs with icon-only buttons.
items.use: Browser-like tab interfaces with icon indicators.
items.text: Browser tab variant displaying icon-only buttons with rounded tops and overlapping z-index layout. When text labels are required for tab identification.

items.name: comp-439
items.title: Badged Count Tabs
items.blurb: Tabs with badge count indicators on each button.
items.use: Tabs tracking quantities like unread messages, pending items, or section sizes.
items.text: Tab buttons with numeric badge indicators showing item counts or notification numbers. Simple content-only tabs without count information.

items.name: comp-44
items.title: OTP Input Grouped
items.blurb: 4-digit OTP input with slots grouped together.
items.use: Verification flows where users enter 4-digit codes and need clear visual slot grouping.
items.text: An OTP field with 4 connected digit slots. Built with input-otp library. Slots are adjacent boxes with the active slot showing a ring. You need variable-length OTP or single-input OTP field.

items.name: comp-440
items.title: Icon Tooltip Tabs
items.blurb: Icon tabs with tooltip on hover.
items.use: Icon-based navigation where text labels appear only on demand via tooltips.
items.text: Icon-only tabs with tooltip labels displayed on hover for accessibility and clarity. When persistent text labels are needed for clarity.

items.name: comp-444
items.title: Vertical Icon Sidebar Tabs
items.blurb: Vertical sidebar with icon buttons and tooltips.
items.use: Minimal vertical sidebar navigation with icon-based UI.
items.text: Vertical sidebar navigation with icon-only buttons and hover tooltips. Compact vertical layout. When persistent text labels needed or horizontal layout required.

items.name: comp-446
items.title: Breadcrumb Ellipsis Dropdown
items.blurb: Breadcrumb with ellipsis dropdown for collapsed items.
items.use: Long breadcrumb trails that need to collapse hidden levels into a dropdown.
items.text: Breadcrumb navigation with ellipsis dropdown that expands to show hidden breadcrumb items. Short breadcrumb paths that fit on one line.

items.name: comp-449
items.title: Breadcrumb With Icons
items.blurb: Breadcrumb with icons accompanying each item.
items.use: Breadcrumbs with visual icons enhancing navigation clarity.
items.text: Breadcrumb where each navigation item includes an accompanying icon. Simple text-only breadcrumbs.

items.name: comp-452
items.title: Breadcrumb Bordered
items.blurb: Bordered breadcrumb items with separation.
items.use: Visual emphasis on breadcrumb items with bordered segments.
items.text: Breadcrumb with borders around individual items, creating distinct segments. Minimal, text-only breadcrumb trails.

items.name: comp-453
items.title: Breadcrumb Select Dropdown
items.blurb: Breadcrumb with dropdown select menu.
items.use: Deep navigation hierarchies where jumping to any level via dropdown is helpful.
items.text: Breadcrumb allowing navigation to any level via dropdown select from the breadcrumb trail. Shallow breadcrumbs or when inline navigation is preferred.

items.name: comp-455
items.title: Ghost Arrow Pagination
items.blurb: Pagination with ghost-style arrow buttons.
items.use: Minimal pagination with ghost button styling fitting light backgrounds.
items.text: Previous/Next pagination using ghost button variant with transparent background styling. When you need prominent button styling or many page options.

items.name: comp-457
items.title: Compact Page Pagination
items.blurb: Compact pagination with page and arrow controls.
items.use: Space-constrained pagination showing position and navigation controls.
items.text: Pagination combining page counter display with previous/next buttons in compact layout. When you need clickable page number list.

items.name: comp-459
items.title: Pagination With Ellipsis
items.blurb: Pagination with ellipsis for page range skipping.
items.use: Large result sets where showing all page numbers would be impractical.
items.text: Pagination displaying page numbers with ellipsis (...) indicating skipped page ranges. Pagination with few pages or when compact display is not needed.

items.name: comp-46
items.title: Phone Number Input
items.blurb: Phone number input with country flag selector.
items.use: Global forms that need to accept phone numbers from multiple countries with visual locale feedback.
items.text: A phone input with an integrated country select dropdown showing country flags. Built with react-phone-number-input library supporting international numbers. You need a minimal input or don't need country selection.

items.name: comp-460
items.title: Pagination First Last
items.blurb: Pagination with first, last, prev, and next buttons.
items.use: Long pagination sequences where jump-to-end is useful.
items.text: Pagination with navigation buttons for First, Previous, Next, and Last page. Simple sequential navigation or short page lists.

items.name: comp-461
items.title: Grouped Pagination
items.blurb: Pagination grouped by category.
items.use: Pagination requiring categorical organization of navigation controls.
items.text: Pagination with navigation controls grouped or arranged by category/section. Simple linear pagination without categorical grouping.

items.name: comp-463
items.title: Pagination Rows Per Page
items.blurb: Pagination with rows per page selector.
items.use: Pagination where users can adjust how many items appear per page.
items.text: Pagination with dropdown to change results per page (items shown per result set). Fixed page size or when users don't need control over results per page.

items.name: comp-464
items.title: Pagination Page Select
items.blurb: Pagination with page number input field.
items.use: Large pagination sets where direct page number entry is faster than clicking.
items.text: Pagination with input field allowing users to directly type and jump to a specific page number. Small pagination ranges or when you want to guide users through sequential pages.

items.name: comp-465
items.title: Pagination With Counter
items.blurb: Numbered pagination with jump-to-page input field.
items.use: You need to navigate large lists and let users jump to specific pages.
items.text: Pagination control with clickable page numbers, ellipsis for skipped ranges, and a text input to jump directly to a page. Infinite scroll or cursor-based pagination is more practical for real-time data.

items.name: comp-467
items.title: Table With Avatars
items.blurb: Table with avatar images in rows for user/team display.
items.use: Showing users, team members, or entities with profile pictures.
items.text: A table variant where one column displays circular avatar images, common for user/contributor lists. Non-user data or when avatars are irrelevant.

items.name: comp-47
items.title: Card Number Input
items.blurb: Credit card number input with card icon.
items.use: Payment forms where automatic card validation and formatting are needed.
items.text: A card number input with a credit card icon on the left. Built with react-payment-inputs library which handles validation and formatting. You need a custom card number handler or want to avoid the library dependency.

items.name: comp-476
items.title: Feature Compatibility Table
items.blurb: Browser compatibility matrix with rotated headers and support indicators.
items.use: Documenting feature support across browsers, building reference tables for CSS capabilities.
items.text: Displays CSS feature support across desktop and mobile browsers with version numbers. Each cell shows a checkmark or X with browser version in a compact, scannable grid with sideways-oriented headers. When data is dynamic or needs frequent updates: data is hardcoded in the component.

items.name: comp-477
items.title: Interactive Selectable Table
items.blurb: Table with multi-select checkboxes and column totals.
items.use: Displaying selectable data records where users need to select multiple rows and see aggregate totals.
items.text: Data table with checkbox column for selecting individual rows and all rows, displaying user data with status badges and currency-formatted balance. Includes footer row showing total balance. Static data only: data fetches from hardcoded URL, not configurable for other datasets.

items.name: comp-479
items.title: Sortable Columns Table
items.blurb: Sortable table with draggable column resizers and keyboard controls.
items.use: Users need to customize table layout and sort multiple columns interactively.
items.text: Data table where columns are sortable with chevron indicators and resizable by dragging handles between headers. Supports keyboard navigation (Enter/Space for sorting) with aria-sort attributes. Data is dynamic with backend sorting: sorting is client-side only.

items.name: comp-480
items.title: Pinnable Columns Table
items.blurb: Table with columns pinnable to left or right edges.
items.use: Wide tables where users need to keep certain columns (like ID or name) visible while scrolling horizontally.
items.text: Data table where columns can be pinned to the left or right side via dropdown menu controls. Pinned columns remain visible during horizontal scroll with sticky positioning and subtle backdrop blur separation. On narrow viewports: pinning reduces horizontal space quickly.

items.name: comp-481
items.title: Draggable Columns Table
items.blurb: Table columns reorderable by dragging, with grip handles and sort controls.
items.use: Users need flexible column arrangement combined with sorting capability.
items.text: Data table where column headers have drag handles to reorder columns horizontally. Each column can also be sorted via chevron button. Uses dnd-kit with horizontal-axis restriction and supports mouse, touch, and keyboard input. On touch-only devices: dragging columns feels awkward compared to native gestures.

items.name: comp-482
items.title: Expandable Rows Table
items.blurb: Table rows that expand to reveal additional details below.
items.use: Tables where users need to see optional details per row without navigating to a detail page.
items.text: Data table with expandable rows showing additional note content. First column has chevron toggle button. Only rows with notes are expandable. Includes row selection checkboxes. When most rows have expandable content: the expand pattern becomes tedious, use a detail view instead.

items.name: comp-483
items.title: Paginated Sortable Table
items.blurb: Paginated table with sortable columns and per-page size control.
items.use: Large datasets that need pagination for performance and sortable columns for organization.
items.text: Data table with pagination controls (first/previous/next/last buttons), adjustable rows per page (5/10/25/50), page info display, and sortable columns with chevrow indicators. Uses aria-live for page info updates. Small datasets under 50 rows: pagination overhead hurts usability.

items.name: comp-485
items.title: Filterable Data Table
items.blurb: Enterprise data table with search, status filters, bulk actions, and column…
items.use: Admin panels or dashboards where users need comprehensive table control: search, filter, view customization, bulk…
items.text: Full-featured data table with multi-column search (name/email), status filter popover with counts, column visibility toggle, sortable columns, pagination controls, row selection, bulk delete with confirmation, row action menu, and add user… Simple read-only data display: too many features add unnecessary complexity.

items.name: comp-491
items.title: Date Range Calendar
items.blurb: Date range picker with start/end selection.
items.use: You need users to pick date ranges (checkin/checkout, report periods).
items.text: A calendar for selecting a date range by clicking a start date then an end date. For single date selection; use a simpler picker.

items.name: comp-50
items.title: Card Details Form
items.blurb: Complete card details form with number, expiry, and CVC.
items.use: Payment flows requiring full card details with card type visual feedback.
items.text: A stacked card entry form with card number (showing dynamic logo), expiry date, and CVC fields. Built with react-payment-inputs, logo updates based on detected card type. You want to split card inputs across multiple steps or need custom card type detection.

items.name: comp-503
items.title: Calendar With Time Input
items.blurb: Calendar with time picker (hour/minute).
items.use: You need users to pick both date and time.
items.text: A calendar with integrated time input (hours and minutes) for selecting a specific date and time. When only dates are needed.

items.name: comp-504
items.title: Advanced Year Month Picker
items.blurb: Year and month picker in one advanced UI.
items.use: You need fast, intuitive year-month navigation without clicking many times.
items.text: An advanced calendar interface allowing simultaneous year and month selection with a grid-based picker. When simple prev/next navigation is preferred.

items.name: comp-505
items.title: Calendar Time Slot Picker
items.blurb: Calendar and time slot selector side-by-side in a responsive layout.
items.use: Users need to book an appointment by picking both date and time.
items.text: A date picker paired with a scrollable time slot list. Selecting a date updates the time slots shown. Disabled slots are unclickable. Small touch screens: the two-column layout becomes cramped on mobile.

items.name: comp-507
items.title: Date Range Preset Picker
items.blurb: Date range picker with preset shortcuts for common ranges.
items.use: Filtering data by date range where users benefit from quick presets like 'Last 30 days' or 'Year to date'.
items.text: Selects a start and end date using a calendar in range mode. Preset buttons set common ranges (Today, Last 7 days, Month to date, etc). Only past dates are available. When only single dates are needed, or when future dates must be selectable.

items.name: comp-508
items.title: Two Month Range Calendar
items.blurb: Two-month calendar view for selecting date ranges at a glance.
items.use: Users need to span a range across two months and appreciate seeing both months simultaneously.
items.text: Displays two consecutive months side-by-side in range mode. Uses paged navigation (forward/back arrows) to move through months. Separator line divides the two calendars. Very small screens where two months don't fit without horizontal scroll.

items.name: comp-51
items.title: Password Strength Input
items.blurb: Password input with strength meter and requirement checklist.
items.use: Registration forms that enforce password quality before submission.
items.text: A password field with an eye toggle, an animated progress bar showing strength (0-4 requirements met), and a checklist of requirements. Color-codes from red (weak) to green (strong). You need a simpler password input or different strength criteria.

items.name: comp-510
items.title: Pricing Calendar
items.blurb: Calendar showing prices under each date with color-coded bargain indicators.
items.use: Flight or hotel bookings where users need to see pricing across dates and identify bargains at a glance.
items.text: Two-month calendar overlaying prices on each day. Good prices (under $100) are highlighted in emerald green. Custom DayButton component renders date + price. Dates without pricing data are disabled. When prices exceed a few characters: they'll overflow the small button space.

items.name: comp-511
items.title: Single Date Popover Picker
items.blurb: Button that opens a calendar in a popover to select a single date.
items.use: You need a compact date picker that saves space by hiding the calendar until clicked.
items.text: A labeled form control with a button trigger showing the selected date or placeholder. Clicking opens a popover with a calendar. Uses Radix Popover and React DayPicker. When users need to see multiple months at once: popovers typically show one month.

items.name: comp-512
items.title: Date Range Popover Picker
items.blurb: Button that opens a calendar popover for selecting a date range.
items.use: You need a compact date range picker that hides the calendar until clicked.
items.text: A labeled form control showing the selected date range or placeholder. Button displays 'Start - End' format. Popover contains a calendar in range mode for selecting both dates. When users need to see two full months simultaneously to span across months.

items.name: comp-53
items.title: Copy to Clipboard Input
items.blurb: Read-only input with a copy-to-clipboard button.
items.use: Commands, codes, or content that users will copy (npm install, API keys, config snippets).
items.text: A read-only text field with a copy button that writes to clipboard and shows a check icon for 1.5 seconds. Includes a tooltip and button disable on copy. The content needs to be editable or you want a different copy feedback.

items.name: comp-543
items.title: Avatar Image Uploader
items.blurb: Avatar uploader with drag-and-drop support and dragging visual feedback.
items.use: Profile or team member avatars with intuitive drag-and-drop.
items.text: Circular avatar upload button that accepts click or drag-drop. Shows hover/dragging state and displays preview when image is loaded. Touch-only devices where drag-and-drop gestures are unclear.

items.name: comp-544
items.title: Image Cover Dropzone
items.blurb: Large dropzone with image preview filling the background.
items.use: Cover images, hero images, or full-width image selections.
items.text: Drag-and-drop upload area that displays selected image as full background when loaded. Shows upload instructions when empty; 5MB size limit. Multiple file uploads; this is single-image only.

items.name: comp-546
items.title: Multi Image Upload Grid
items.blurb: Grid layout for uploading and previewing multiple images.
items.use: Bulk photo uploads, gallery management, product image sets.
items.text: Multi-image uploader with drag-and-drop support, displaying thumbnails in a grid layout. Each image can be individually removed. Single image uploads; use single-file variants instead.

items.name: comp-549
items.title: Multi File Upload List
items.blurb: Vertical list upload for multiple files with details and progress.
items.use: Bulk document uploads, file management interfaces, or detailed progress tracking.
items.text: Multi-file uploader in list format showing file names, sizes, and upload progress. Each file has individual remove control. Quick image galleries; use grid layout instead.

items.name: comp-551
items.title: File Upload Table View
items.blurb: File uploads displayed in a data table with sortable columns.
items.use: Enterprise file management, data-heavy upload flows, or large file collections.
items.text: Multi-file upload manager using table layout. Shows file name, size, upload date, status with sortable columns and bulk actions. Mobile or responsive contexts; tables don't scale well.

items.name: comp-553
items.title: Mixed File Upload Manager
items.blurb: File uploader listing files with type icons and per-file progress bars with remove controls.
items.use: Multi-file uploads that need visible progress per file.
items.text: Multi-file uploader displaying both images as thumbnails and other files as type icons in a single grid. All removable. File-type-specific flows; use specialized variants for single-type focus.

items.name: comp-57
items.title: Inline Tags Input
items.blurb: Tag input with tags displayed inline alongside the input.
items.use: Compact tag entry where space is limited and inline display is preferred.
items.text: A tag input built with emblor where tags appear inline in the same container as the input field. Starts with Red tag. Close buttons for each tag. You need tags in a separate list below the input (see comp-56).

items.name: comp-578
items.title: Mega Menu Navbar
items.blurb: Mega menu navbar with icon, description, and simple submenu types.
items.use: You need multi-level navigation with mixed content types (descriptions, icons, simple links) in a compact header.
items.text: Responsive header with desktop mega menu (descriptions/icons/simple items) and mobile popover. Collapses cleanly at breakpoint. Simple linear navigation; mega menus add complexity and desk space.

items.name: comp-580
items.title: Ecommerce Search Navbar
items.blurb: E-commerce navbar with search, mobile cart badge, category links.
items.use: E-commerce or retail app with product search and quick cart access in the header.
items.text: Header with logo, search input (desktop + mobile), category nav, cart/sign-in buttons. Mobile menu hides nav, includes cart counter. Content-heavy sites; search placement competes with other navigation.

items.name: comp-581
items.title: Minimal Auth Navbar
items.blurb: Minimal navbar with logo, nav links, info/notification/user menus.
items.use: SaaS or apps needing a polished, uncluttered header with user account features.
items.text: Clean header with logo, simple nav links, and icon-based menus (info, notifications, user). Responsive mobile menu. Heavy content navigation or mega menus.

items.name: comp-582
items.title: Icon Nav With Language Select
items.blurb: Icon-only navbar with language selector and theme toggle.
items.use: Global apps needing language/theme controls at the top with a compact icon-based nav.
items.text: Header with icon nav links, language select dropdown, and theme toggle. Icons shown with tooltips on desktop; text labels on mobile. Users unfamiliar with icon-only interfaces.

items.name: comp-583
items.title: Breadcrumb Project Header
items.blurb: Breadcrumb header with dropdown project selector.
items.use: Multi-tenant or project-based apps showing user location in hierarchy with quick project switching.
items.text: Header showing breadcrumb navigation with account/project hierarchy. Project selector is a dropdown menu. Notification and user menus included. Linear navigation; breadcrumbs are better for deep hierarchies.

items.name: comp-584
items.title: Simple Nav Header
items.blurb: Navbar with search bar and bottom nav menu strip.
items.use: Apps with central search as a key feature, plus secondary navigation underneath the header.
items.text: Header with logo, search input, notifications, and user menu. Below-header strip with text nav links. Responsive: mobile hides nav strip. Limited vertical space; this layout takes two rows at minimum on desktop.

items.name: comp-587
items.title: App Icon Nav Header
items.blurb: Icon navbar with app shortcuts, notifications, and upgrade button.
items.use: Product suites or multi-app platforms where users need quick app switching.
items.text: Header with icon navigation menu, app switcher menu (multiple apps), notifications, user dropdown, and highlighted upgrade button. Single-app experiences; app switcher adds visual weight.

items.name: comp-589
items.title: Breadcrumb Version Header
items.blurb: Breadcrumb header with double-dropdown for account/project selection.
items.use: Multi-tenant apps where users manage multiple accounts or projects and need quick switching.
items.text: Header with breadcrumb showing account and project dropdowns. Secondary nav menu below (desktop only). Notifications and user menus included. Single-account or flat hierarchy; breadcrumbs and dropdowns add cognitive load.

items.name: comp-590
items.title: Team Nav Header
items.blurb: Icon navbar with team switcher, post button, and status badges.
items.use: Content creation or social platforms with team management and quick-publish flows.
items.text: Header with team switcher, icon nav menu, post button, notifications, and user menu. Compact icon layout for content creation apps. Text-heavy navigation; this layout is icon-first.

items.name: comp-591
items.title: AI Model Selector Header
items.blurb: AI model selector header with chat and user menus.
items.use: LLM/AI chat interfaces where users frequently switch between different model options.
items.text: Header with AI model dropdown (showing descriptions), chat layout toggle, and user menu. Minimal, focused on model selection. Simple apps; model selector adds cognitive load.

items.name: comp-593
items.title: Breadcrumb Filter Header
items.blurb: Breadcrumb report header with date picker and filters.
items.use: Report or dashboard interfaces where users filter data by date/range.
items.text: Header with breadcrumb (home icon + page title), date picker, filters panel, and save/bookmark button. Simple content pages; breadcrumbs + filters add navigation weight.

items.name: comp-595
items.title: Collab Nav Header
items.blurb: Collaboration navbar with back button, header title, and action buttons.
items.use: Collaborative editors or team workspaces where seeing active collaborators is important.
items.text: Header with back button, page title, history/comments/add-user buttons, and avatar stack showing online collaborators. Single-user apps; presence data adds visual noise.

items.name: comp-596
items.title: Nav Switch Header
items.blurb: Status navbar with badges and animated power toggle.
items.use: DevOps or infrastructure dashboards showing system status and control.
items.text: Header with nav tabs, online/uptime/latency badges, and animated power on/off toggle (motion-based state switch). User-facing interfaces; status badges are for monitoring only.

items.name: comp-73
items.title: Textarea Inset Label
items.blurb: Label sits inset at the top of the bordered textarea field.
items.use: Designing compact forms where labels are visually integrated into the field itself.
items.text: A textarea where the label is positioned inside the top of the bordered container as a permanent visual element, creating a unified field appearance. When label text is lengthy or needs to be hidden from view.

items.name: comp-98
items.title: Animated Plus Toggle
items.blurb: Plus icon rotates 135° on toggle.
items.use: You need a visual toggle that shows open/closed state through icon rotation.
items.text: A state-driven Button that rotates the Plus icon 135 degrees with a cubic-bezier ease when clicked, using aria-expanded to track state. When users expect a plus-to-minus transition rather than rotation.

items.name: compare
items.title: Image Compare Slider
items.blurb: Side-by-side image slider with hover or drag to reveal and compare two images.
items.use: Before-and-after comparisons, product variations, or demonstrating transformations side by side.
items.text: Displays two images with a draggable divider. Move the slider by hovering or dragging to reveal portions of each image. Optional autoplay cycles between images. Includes decorative glow and star effects. Mobile-only contexts or when both images must be fully visible simultaneously.

items.name: components-backgrounds-bubble
items.title: Bubble Background
items.blurb: Animated blur orbs float and pulse across the background.
items.use: Modern gradient background with soft blob aesthetic.
items.text: Motion/react background with six configurable color orbs using blur effects. Optional interactive mode for pointer tracking with spring physics. Performance-critical pages or high frame rate requirements.

items.name: components-backgrounds-fireworks
items.title: Fireworks Background
items.blurb: Continuous random colored particles explode from the screen with physics.
items.use: Celebratory or playful animated background.
items.text: Canvas-based particle system with gravity and friction physics. Generates random RGB colored explosions that decay over time, simulating fireworks effect. Serious or minimal aesthetic design, or photosensitive users.

items.name: components-backgrounds-gravity-stars
items.title: Gravity Stars Background
items.blurb: Stars drift and orbit under simulated gravity, attracted or repelled by cursor.
items.use: Interactive space-themed background with physics simulation.
items.text: Canvas-based particle system with physics simulation. 75 stars affected by gravity, with optional mouse attraction/repulsion and star-to-star bounce or merge interactions. Performance-constrained devices or when static background needed.

items.name: components-backgrounds-hexagon
items.title: Hexagon Background
items.blurb: Tessellating hexagons that lighten on hover.
items.use: A geometric background that needs subtle interaction to draw attention to hovered areas.
items.text: Renders a responsive grid of clip-path hexagons that fills the viewport. Each hexagon lightens on hover with a smooth transition. When the viewport is very small or performance is critical: the grid recalculates on resize and may be heavy on mobile.

items.name: components-backgrounds-hole
items.title: Hole Background
items.blurb: Discs and particles stream through an elliptical hole, animated continuously.
items.use: A dramatic, animated page background that should command visual attention without user interaction.
items.text: Canvas-based background with concentric discs tweening downward through a central hole and particles falling through. Runs a continuous RAF loop with radial gradient overlays. Performance-sensitive pages or mobile devices: the RAF loop runs constantly and never idles, consuming significant…

items.name: components-community-flip-card
items.title: Flip Card
